end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Identified a wheel as sphere-like and a toy nose as cone-like.
Explained that a cylinder has two flat faces.
Teach-back was not passed; unaided correct attempts: 0/3.
A cone/sphere mix-up was later answered as sphere (turn 12).
end.parentNote: Asha practised shape names using parts of toys and asked Aditya to explain their features. They described wheels as sphere-like, noses as cone-like, and identified the two flat faces of a cylinder. There was a cone/sphere mix-up, which was corrected later when they answered “sphere.” At home, ask them to find one toy or household object for each shape and name it.
